positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintained and modified public website (HTML web pages, Perl/CGI and SSL certificate), Java EE Java Server Faces (JSF) PrimeFaces web application and Apache Derby database to meet business requirements.

Modified Perl/CGI script to email college student shuttle requests in JSON format to email account monitored by web application and modified web application to process requests, send emails to student/parents, update student shuttle trips in database and email office personnel, accordingly.

Developed SSL HTML web page to submit customer credit card information to Stripe.com, developed Perl/CGI script to send payment request emails to email account monitored by web application, and modified web application to process payment requests via Stripe.com JAVA API and send credit card payment success/failure emails to customers and office personnel.

Developed Java EE web application to accept, process and/or queue JAX-RS HTTP requests from JSF web application to update information on Google Calendar via Google Calendar REST API and MessageDrivenBeans (MDBs) via TomEE and Apache ActiveMQ; the code was migrated from the JSF web application.

Modified Perl/CGI scripts on public website to email customer requests in JSON format to email account monitored by JSF web application, modified JSF web application to process and add these requests to database and email office personnel, accordingly.

Migrated legacy MS-DOS dBASE IV application to JSF web application via NetBeans, Java Derby database, TomEE, GlassFish, MyFaces, Mojarra, and PrimeFaces.

Developed Java application to pipeline data from dBASE IV to Apache Derby database.

Developed Apache Derby database (80+ tables), which was derived from 6 tables in the legacy MS-DOS dBase IV application; used SQL to create tables, primary/foreign key constraints and to insert data into a few tables in the database.

Developed and maintained a dBASE IV application.

positions.title: PowerBuilder Developer & Subject Matter Expert (SME)
positions.description:
Performed analysis/research of legacy/PowerBuilder version of software, to help two separate (Java EE) teams to develop Java EE gizmo/components which meet requirements of the legacy software  
 
Provided assistance/guidance to Java EE developers via chat, email, and phone conference; shared my desktop via Webex or Microsoft Communicator to explain/interpret legacy/PowerBuilder source code  
 
Developed and maintained Word documents and Excel spreadsheets that helped Java EE teams to develop software  
 
Discussed and provided SOAP XML request and response envelopes for several SOAP operations to Java EE teams  
 
Discussed, compared, and reviewed PowerBuilder and Java EE source code to meet software requirements  
 
Performed analysis and testing of legacy/PowerBuilder version of software to help triage Java EE software defects  
 
Participated in development of 2015 February version of the legacy/PowerBuilder version of the software; changes to PowerBuilder version of software; triage of software defects 
 
Environment: PowerBuilder 12.5, HP Application Life Cycle Management, Microsoft Office Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Infomaker, Communicator, Paint, Notepad++, Fieldglass (timesheet), and Microsoft Windows XP/7.

positions.title: PowerBuilder Developer
positions.description:
• Assigned to the Laptop Case Management (LCM) team which develop and maintain software for the Field Representative Laptop System (FRLS).
• Migrated PowerBuilder 8 application to PowerBuilder 11.5, made code changes to meet requirements, deployed application to new platform which is a Hewlett Packard (HP) laptop with Microsoft Vista SP2 installed, copied application files from platform currently in production which is a Dell laptop with Microsoft Windows 2000, and recommended changes to be made to the Windows Vista image that was being developed by another team.
• Developed a PowerBuilder 8 and 11.5 data transfer application that connects to an Oracle 9i Lite database on a Windows 2000 laptop, dumps data into XML files, dumps LONG RAW data into separate files, creates SQL file for each table and column included in the transfer, connects to Oracle 10g Lite database on a Windows Vista laptop, reads the SQL, XML, and LONG RAW data files to import data into the Oracle 10g Lite database,and creates LOG files.

Environment: PowerBuilder 8 and 11.5, Oracle 9i Lite, Oracle 10g Lite, and Microsoft Windows 200, XP, and Vista.

positions.title: PowerBuilder Developer
positions.description:
• Developed a PowerBuilder standalone application that connects to an operating production database (Sybase Adaptive Server Anywhere), creates a reporting database (Sybase Adaptive Server Anywhere), and transfers data from the operating database to the reporting database.
• Used the UNLOAD utility of Sybase Central to get the DDL for creating the Sybase production database; used the DDL to create the Sybase reporting database, a replica of the production database minus certain tables and column, foreign keys, stored procedures, functions, and triggers.
• Used Windows Scheduled Tasks to schedule execution of the reporting database application
• Developed the deployment strategy for the reporting database application on servers and the Sybase ODBC driver on workstations.
• Developed the install guide and user guide for the reporting database application with the assistance of the technical writer.
• Developed a test procedure and the test environment for the reporting database application.
• Learned Crystal Reports XI, to connect to the Sybase reporting database and create report that selects data from reporting database.
• Modified a PowerBuilder/EAServer 3-tier distributed application to connect to an IBM UniVerse SQL database via ODBC.
• Modified datawindow and embedded SQL, to execute successfully against an IBM UniVerse SQL (ANSI SQL-92) DB.
• Moved stored procedure from Sybase DB to EAServer component, since IBM UniVerse did not support stored procedures.
• Lead development of a prototype & facilitated meetings with development staff to place estimates on the tasks necessary to make PB/EAServer application support Sybase Adaptive Server and IBM UniVerse.

Environment: PowerBuilder 9.0, Sybase Enterprise Application Server (EAServer or Jaguar CTS) 4.2.3, Sybase Adaptive Server Anywhere (ASA) 8.0.2, Windows 2003 Server, IBM UniVerse 10.2, Sybase Central, Sybase Interactive SQL, Crystal Reports XI, and Microsoft Windows XP.

positions.title: PowerBuilder, SQL, and SQR Developer
positions.description:
• Assigned to participate on the SMS Performance Enhancement project to enhance the performance of the PowerBuilder 8.0 - UNIX/C - SQR - Sybase ASE 12.5 client-server application.
• Improved the performance of the generation of a report by over 90% by converting inefficient PowerBuilder 8.0 source code to SQL, to be executed in a database stored procedure.
• Helped to debug and resolve testing defects related to the SMS Performance Enhancement project.
• Made PowerBuilder 8.0 source code changes to resolve a falsely-assumed system-crash-rollback error; had to sort datawindows, get a group of loan numbers from the primary datawindow, create a filter for the range of loan numbers to be used to filter the supporting datawindows, and issue datawindow updates and a COMMIT, accordingly, so that 4 database tables would be updated with each group of loan numbers.
• Created and maintained PowerBuilder 8.0 objects, Sybase ASE 12.5 stored procedures, and SQR source files to fulfil new requirements and change requests.
• Used UNIX SCCS for UNIX/C, SQR, and stored procedure source files; no source control for PowerBuilder 8.0 source code, so, often had to repeat my PowerBuilder source code changes.

Environment: PowerBuilder 8.0, Sybase Adaptive Server Enterprise (ASE) 12.5, Sun Solaris 10, Hyperion SQR Server 8.3.1, and Microsoft Windows XP.
